title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Further Strengthening the Work of Financial Adjudication
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Several Opinions on Further Strengthening Financial Adjudication Work"

Fa Fa [2017] No. 22

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "Several Opinions on Further Strengthening Financial Adjudication Work" of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

August 4, 2017

Several Opinions on Further Strengthening Financial Adjudication Work

Finance is an important core competitiveness of the country, financial security is an important component of national security, and the financial system is an important foundational system in economic and social development. To fully leverage the role of the people's courts' financial adjudication functions and promote a virtuous cycle and healthy development of the economy and finance, the following guiding opinions are hereby put forward.

I. Unify Thinking, Raise Awareness, and Deeply Study and Implement the Spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech at the National Financial Work Conference

The important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the Fifth National Financial Work Conference scientifically answered major theoretical and practical issues concerning China's financial reform, development, and stability. It is highly ideological, guiding, and practical, providing fundamental guidance for financial work under the new situation and pointing the direction for the financial adjudication work of the people's courts. People's courts at all levels across the country must deeply study and implement the spirit of the conference, effectively unify their thoughts and actions with the Central Committee's analysis, judgment, and decision-making deployment on financial work, firmly adhere to the Party's unified leadership over financial work, closely focus on the three tasks of serving the real economy, preventing and controlling financial risks, and deepening financial reform, actively and prudently carry out financial adjudication work, effectively safeguard national financial security, and promote a virtuous cycle and healthy development of the economy and finance.

II. Take Serving the Real Economy as the Starting Point and Goal, Guide and Regulate Financial Transactions

1. Follow financial rules and adjudicate financial cases according to law. Adjudicate various types of financial cases according to law, taking financial services serving the real economy as the fundamental value. Protect financial transaction models that can actually reduce transaction costs, achieve inclusive finance, and are lawful and compliant. For financial misconduct that conceals financial risks, evades financial regulation, or engages in regulatory arbitrage under the guise of financial innovation, determine their validity and the rights and obligations of each party based on the legal relationship actually constituted. Where illegal absorption of public deposits or fundraising fraud under the name of financial innovation constitutes a crime, investigate criminal liability according to law.

2. Strictly regulate usury according to law, effectively reduce the financing cost of the real economy. Where a borrower under a financial loan contract requests a reduction of the portion of total interest, compound interest, penalty interest, liquidated damages, and other fees claimed simultaneously by the lender that significantly exceeds 24% per annum, on the grounds that they are excessively high and clearly deviate from actual losses, such request shall be supported to effectively reduce the financing cost of the real economy. Regulate and guide the order of private lending, and deny according to law the validity of contract terms in private lending dispute cases that evade the upper limit of judicial protection of private lending interest rates, such as deducting principal or interest in advance, or disguised high interest rates.

3. Determine the legal validity of new types of guarantees according to law, broaden the financing guarantee methods for small, medium, and micro enterprises. Enrich and expand the financing guarantee methods for small, medium, and micro enterprises. Except where the contract is invalid as provided in Article 52 of the Contract Law, the validity of new-type guarantee contracts shall be determined according to law; if the provisions on security interests in the Property Law are met, their real right effect shall also be determined according to law, so as to enhance the financing capacity of small, medium, and micro enterprises and effectively alleviate the difficulties and high costs of financing for them.

4. Regulate and promote financing methods that directly serve the real economy, broaden the channels for finance to connect with the real economy. Protect financing models that combine financial capital with the real economy, such as financial leasing and factoring, according to law, and support and ensure financial capital serves the real economy. For contracts that are named as financial leasing contracts or factoring contracts but are actually loan contracts, the rights and obligations of each party shall be determined according to the actual constituted loan contract relationship, preventing parties from indirectly raising the financing cost of the real economy through methods such as deducting rent or deposits in advance.

5. Optimize the legal environment of the multi-level capital market system to meet diverse financial needs. Adjudicate securities and futures civil and commercial dispute cases according to law, regulate the investment and financing order in the capital market, guide the allocation of more financial resources to key areas and weak links in economic and social development, and better meet the diverse financial needs of the real economy.

6. Accurately apply the Insurance Law, promote the insurance industry to perform its functions of long-term and stable risk management and protection. Properly adjudicate insurance contract dispute cases, protect the interests of all parties according to law. Fully leverage the core functions of the insurance system to manage and diversify risks such as natural disasters, accidents, legal liabilities, and credit in the operation of the real economy. Regulate the conduct of various market entities, such as parties to insurance contract disputes and insurance intermediaries, according to law, prevent moral hazards of different entities, and build a legal system for insurance integrity.

7. Adjudicate internet finance dispute cases according to law, regulate the development of internet finance. Determine the specific legal relationships involved in internet finance according to law, and accordingly determine the rights and obligations of each party. Accurately characterize the intermediary contract relationship between online lending information intermediary institutions and parties to online lending contracts. Where online lending information intermediary institutions and lenders evade the upper limit of judicial protection of private lending interest rates in the form of intermediary fees, such fees shall be deemed invalid. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts involving internet finance or conducted under the guise of internet finance according to law, regulate and ensure the healthy development of internet finance.

8. Strengthen research and response to new types of financial cases, unify adjudication standards. Pay close attention to cases involving new types of financial transactions such as private equity investment, entrusted wealth management, and asset management. Strictly follow legal norms such as the Contract Law, Company Law, Partnership Enterprise Law, and Trust Law to determine the rights and obligations of each party. Issue guiding cases, and through guidance by similar cases, unify adjudication standards.

9. Regulate the loan channel business of state-owned enterprises according to law, prevent state-owned enterprises without financial qualifications from engaging in financial business in disguised form. Where state-owned enterprises without financial qualifications engage in financial business in disguised form, obtain credit funds from financial institutions and then relend them at high interest, the legal validity of such lending conduct shall be denied according to law, in accordance with Article 14 of the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Private Lending Cases. Through methods such as issuing judicial suggestions to the corresponding competent authorities, curb the loan channel business of state-owned enterprises and guide them back to the real economy.

10. Combat illegal and criminal acts in fund brokers and fund intermediation according to law, effectively regulate financial order. For acts in private lending involving collusion between commercial bank employees and outsiders for high-interest relending or interest transfer, or where employees of financial institutions illegally grant loans, or where companies or enterprises fabricate facts or conceal the truth to defraud loans or commit loan fraud during the loan application process, if such acts constitute crimes, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

III. Effectively Prevent and Defuse Financial Risks, Conscientiously Safeguard Financial Security

11. Dispose of "zombie enterprises" according to law, promote economic deleveraging. Strengthen bankruptcy trial work and institutional mechanism construction, fully leverage the institutional function of bankruptcy proceedings in disposing of "zombie enterprises" according to law. For "zombie enterprises" that have lost market competitiveness and operational value, conduct bankruptcy liquidation in a timely manner, orderly withdraw from the market, effectively reduce ineffective supply, defuse overcapacity, release production factors, and lower corporate leverage ratios, providing strong judicial services and guarantees for deepening supply-side structural reform.

12. Fully leverage the rescue function of the bankruptcy reorganization system, promote the regeneration of valuable but distressed enterprises. Improve and refine the identification mechanism for bankrupt enterprises. For enterprises that, despite losing solvency, are still able to adapt to market needs and possess operational value, comprehensively utilize bankruptcy reorganization and conciliation system measures to rescue them, optimize resource allocation, and achieve enterprise regeneration. The bankruptcy reorganization process should adhere to market-oriented orientation, place greater emphasis on business integration and asset reorganization during reorganization, and strictly and prudently apply the compulsory approval power for reorganization plans in accordance with the law.

13. Actively prevent bankruptcy cases from triggering financial risks and maintain social stability. Prudently handle bankruptcy cases that may trigger financial risks or affect social stability, especially enterprise bankruptcy cases involving mutual or chain guarantees, as well as private financing or illegal fundraising, to avoid regional risks and mass incidents. Further improve the bankruptcy system design for specific entities such as listed companies and financial institutions, prevent individual cases from triggering systemic financial risks. Strictly review malicious evasion of debt in bankruptcy proceedings. Apply methods such as consolidated bankruptcy of affiliated enterprises, exercise of bankruptcy avoidance rights and right of retrieval, to locate and recover debtor property. For criminal acts such as concealing or intentionally destroying accounting books or vouchers, or refusing to enforce court judgments or rulings, investigate criminal liability according to law.

14. Protect financial creditor rights according to law, enhance the efficiency of realizing financial creditor rights. Combat acts of evading financial creditor rights according to law, clarify the subject and scope of liability, and effectively protect financial creditor rights. According to the characteristics of specific financial loan contract dispute cases, apply different procedures such as ordinary procedure, summary procedure, special procedure, and supervision procedure respectively, to improve trial efficiency. Effectively leverage the role of notarized certificates with compulsory execution effect to reduce the cost of realizing financial creditor rights.

15. Adjudicate bill dispute cases according to law, properly resolve bill risks. Carefully study and respond to financial risks that may be triggered by illegal bill financing activities, accurately apply the Negotiable Instruments Law in adjudicating bill dispute cases, effectively prevent and curb bill risks, and promote the safe and stable development of the bill market.

16. Adjudicate cases concerning non-performing financial creditor rights according to law, ensure the lawful disposal of non-performing financial creditor rights. Strengthen research on new situations and problems arising in the disposal of non-performing financial creditor rights under the new situation, unify adjudication standards, and promote the market-oriented and law-based process of disposing of non-performing financial creditor rights.

17. Maintain a sustained high-pressure stance against illegal fundraising crimes, effectively safeguard social stability. Adjudicate illegal fundraising cases fairly and efficiently according to law, severely crack down on illegal fundraising crimes. Given the characteristics of illegal fundraising crime cases—large number of participants, large amounts involved, wide scope, and relative concentration in industries and regions—strengthen information communication and coordination with functional organs and local governments, enhance disposal effectiveness, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of victims, and effectively maintain social stability.

18. Ensure the stable and healthy development of the real estate market according to law, prevent the transmission of financial risks from the real estate market. Attach great importance to the impact of real estate market fluctuations on financial creditor rights, properly adjudicate relevant cases according to law, effectively prevent the transmission and impact of potential risks in the real estate market on financial stability and security. Unify adjudication standards for the validity of contracts that circumvent the national housing purchase restriction policies, such as purchasing houses in another's name, guide real estate transactions back to their residential attribute.

19. Severely punish securities crimes according to law, maintain capital market order. Adjudicate cases of fraudulent issuance of stocks and bonds, cases of illegal disclosure or non-disclosure of important information, cases of insider trading, cases of trading using undisclosed information, and cases of manipulating securities or futures markets, prevent and defuse systemic risks in the capital market, and promote the sustained and healthy development of the capital market.

20. Strengthen judicial protection of investors' civil rights and interests, safeguard investors' property safety. Adjudicate civil cases concerning false statements, insider trading, and market manipulation in the securities market according to law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of securities investors. Support securities investor protection institutions in accepting investors' entrustment as litigation representatives to initiate lawsuits or provide specialized legal services, expand investors' rights protection methods. Explore the establishment of a system of lawyer investigation orders in the field of securities tort civil litigation, enhance investors' evidence-gathering capacity. Fully and lawfully utilize expert witnesses and expert juror systems, expand the knowledge capacity and depth of adjudication in securities cases, and improve the professionalism and credibility of securities case adjudication. Guide financial product providers and service providers to earnestly fulfill obligations of investor suitability review, information disclosure, and maximum loss disclosure, safeguard investors' legitimate rights and interests according to law.

21. Regulate and rectify illegal trading activities of local trading venues, prevent and defuse regional financial risks. For illegal or non-compliant trading activities conducted by local trading venues without permission or beyond the scope of business license, strictly apply the prohibitive provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations, deny their legal validity, and clarify the civil liability of the trading venues. Effectively strengthen the connection between administrative disposal work and judicial adjudication work in cases involving local trading venues, effectively prevent regional financial risks.

22. Adjudicate cases concerning local government debt disputes according to law, prevent local government debt risks. Determine the legal liability for illegal guarantees provided by the government according to law, regulate government conduct. Determine the nature, validity, and liability of administrative acts or administrative agreements concluded by local governments using platform companies to finance, public-private partnerships (PPPs), investment funds, and purchase services, etc., in disguised form of borrowing, clarify adjudication rules, delineate the boundary of liability, and effectively prevent the accumulation of local government debt risks.

23. Adjudicate cases concerning foreign investment according to law, strengthen the prevention and response to external financial risks. Strengthen research and response to financial security and financial risk issues in cross-border investment under the "Belt and Road" initiative, accurately determine the legal validity of cross-border investment acts that circumvent national foreign exchange control policies.

IV. Serve and Support Financial Reform According to Law, Establish and Improve New Mechanisms Adapted to the Needs of Financial Adjudication Work

24. Support financial regulatory authorities in performing their duties according to law, supervise and promote financial regulatory authorities in exercising their powers according to law. Closely cooperate with the requirements of financial reform and the adjustment of financial regulatory authorities, maintain the statutory performance of regulatory duties by financial regulatory authorities. Adjudicate various types of administrative cases involving financial regulatory authorities in granting administrative permits and approvals, making administrative penalties and dispositions, disclosing government information, and failing to perform statutory duties, actively promote, supervise, and support financial regulatory authorities in exercising their powers according to law.

25. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with financial regulatory authorities, promote the improvement of the financial legal system. Explore the establishment of communication mechanisms between people's courts and financial regulatory authorities, regularly inform about important cases concerning financial risk prevention and financial security, strengthen the connection and cooperation between financial regulation and financial adjudication, and promote the formation of a unified and complete financial legal system.

26. Effectively introduce external resources, explore and improve diversified dispute resolution mechanisms for financial cases. Promote the successful experience of connecting litigation with mediation in the securities, futures, and insurance industries. Cooperate with relevant financial regulatory authorities, industry associations, and investor protection institutions, utilize professional resource advantages to prevent and resolve financial disputes. Further smooth channels for litigants to express claims and seek rights relief, through pre-filing referral mediation, post-filing entrusted mediation, and other methods, promote the lawful, fair, and efficient resolution of financial disputes, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties.

27. Establish a financial adjudication information platform, continuously improve the informatization level of financial adjudication. In conjunction with the construction of "smart courts," explore the establishment of a financial adjudication information platform, research and establish an information management system for civil and commercial cases with financial institutions as parties, reflect in real time the litigation-related information of financial institutions. Establish a special reporting system for major financial cases, promptly study and respond to measures, effectively prevent the transmission and expansion of financial risks. Fully utilize judicial big data, strengthen trial management and analysis of financial cases, regularly form big data analysis reports on financial adjudication, research and solve general and trend legal issues, and provide information support for the prevention and early warning of regional, industry, and systemic financial risks and for major decision-making.

V. Strengthen Judicial Capability Building, Continuously Improve the Professional Level of Financial Adjudication

28. Based on the characteristics of financial cases, explore the establishment of specialized financial adjudication institutions. According to the distribution of financial institutions and the number of financial cases, select some courts in areas where financial cases are relatively concentrated to set up financial adjudication tribunals, explore the implementation of centralized jurisdiction over financial cases. In other intermediate people's courts with a larger number of financial cases, specialized financial adjudication tribunals or collegial panels for financial adjudication may be established based on the case situation.

29. Strengthen the professional construction of the financial adjudication team, provide talent guarantee for financial adjudication. Enrich the financial adjudication teams of people's courts at all levels, improve the training mechanism for financial adjudication professionals, including exchanges and secondments with financial regulatory agencies and joint business exchanges, carry out targeted special training on financial adjudication, strive to cultivate a high-quality financial adjudication team that understands both law and finance, and continuously improve the professional level of financial adjudication.

30. Strengthen research on financial justice, promote the deep integration of financial legal theory and financial adjudication practice. Strengthen cooperation with academic institutions and universities, deepen theoretical research on financial adjudication around practical issues in financial adjudication, and provide intellectual support for financial adjudication.
